slides.title: Why you cannot say no to those *eyes.*
slides.sub: There is a muscle for that. Swipe.

slides.title: Dogs have a special eyebrow muscle.
slides.body: It lifts the inner part of the brow. It makes the eyes look bigger.

slides.title: Wolves mostly do not.
slides.body: Researchers at the University of Portsmouth compared the two. Dogs had the muscle. Wolves mostly did not.

slides.title: It may be a gift for us.
slides.body: Scientists think people may have favored dogs with this look. That is a theory, not proof.

slides.title: So at drop off, the eyes come out.
slides.body: Stay calm. Keep it short. We take it from here.

posts.caption:
Why you cannot say no to those eyes.

Researchers at the University of Portsmouth found that dogs have a small muscle that lifts the inner brow. Wolves mostly do not have it. The study was published in PNAS in 2019.

Scientists think people may have favored dogs with this look. That is a theory, not proof.

So at drop off, the eyes may come out. Stay calm and keep it short. We take it from here.

Source: PNAS, 2019, University of Portsmouth.
